# reconcile-diagnose fixtures (DRAFT-documented-shape)

Invented files for `node scripts/reconcile-usage.ts --diagnose` and its tests (`test/reconcile/diagnose.test.ts`, and the last three
cases of `--selftest`). **No line here came from a real session.** Every text field (instructions, prompts, replies, compacted
history, working directories, branches) holds a `SENTINEL_<WORD>_dg` string, so a test can prove the diagnostic never prints one.
The invented values follow the documented collector shapes, including `compacted`, `token_usage_record`, `forked_from_id`,
`multi_agent_version` and `history_mode`. The importer follows the [ccusage counting rules](../../../docs/implementation/ccusage-rules.md).
The hand-written oracles count differently so the diagnostic has discrepancies to identify.

| Folder or file         | What it is built to show                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `home/.codex/` `a1a1…` | A root rollout with a `compacted` line, a `token_usage_record` whose `response_id` matches it (usage 400 + 50, turn usage 380 + 50) and one that does not (70 + 30). The importer counts the snapshots' 2250 plus the matching record's 450 (2700), as the real ccusage does; the PRETEND oracle counts 2250 only. |
| `home/.codex/` `b2b2…` | A forked, spawned child. Its first two events are copies of the parent's, found by comparison and skipped by the importer (650), as the real ccusage does; the PRETEND oracle skips nothing (2900), which only the no-prefix candidates reproduce.                                                                 |
| `home/.codex/` `c3c3…` | A rollout with usage and no `turn_context` model. It is not in the oracle: an "only in the app" session.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `home/.claude/` `d1`   | A main transcript with messages `m1` and `m2`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `home/.claude/` `d2`   | A resumed session: its copy of `m2` is stamped later than `d1`'s, then its own `m3`. The PRETEND oracle gives `m2` to the LATER copy, so the importer (larger total, then the first path) is off by the same 2045 tokens in opposite directions on the two sessions, and only the "latest" rule gets both right.   |
| `home/.claude/` `d3`   | A session whose only message names the `<synthetic>` model. It is not in the oracle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `codex-oracle.json`    | The two Codex sessions in the shape `ccusage codex session --json --offline` has (input without its cached part).                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `claude-oracle.json`   | The two Claude Code sessions in the shape `ccusage claude session --json --offline` has.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
